profile.headline: Sr. Software Developer
profile.summary:
I’m an electrical and software engineer with a background in control systems, automation, and enterprise software architecture. I hold both a BS and MS in Electrical & Computer Engineering from UCSB with an emphasis in control and image processing, and I’ve built my career designing and integrating complex systems that bridge physical automation and large-scale software platforms.

  

Early in my career, I supervised automation installations and maintained industrial control systems at Modelo Brewery in Mexico City, working with Siemens and Allen-Bradley platforms to support large-scale industrial production. I later moved into academia where I founded Mexico’s first engineering program in Interactive Technology and Digital Animation while also directing the Mechatronics major at Universidad del Valle de México. In that role I guided faculty and students, developed national engineering curricula across more than 20 campuses, mentored award-winning robotics teams, and built industry partnerships nationally and internationally.

  

More recently, as a Senior Software Developer at Entertainment Partners, I led coding standards development and the modernization and optimization of large-scale legacy C-based systems supporting the entertainment production industry. My ability to quickly understand complex domains allowed me to collaborate closely with stakeholders to define requirements and deliver solutions that consistently exceeded expectations.

  

Today I bring a rare[rich] combination of hands-on control systems expertise and advanced software architecture experience. I approach engineering with a systems-level mindset, aligning technical decisions with business impact while architecting scalable solutions, modernizing legacy platforms, mentoring engineers, and collaborating effectively with executives, engineers, and clients. Whether working with PLC-based automation, system integration, or enterprise applications, my focus is on building reliable, high-performance systems that deliver measurable results.

positions.title: Sr. Software Developer
positions.description:
Provided expert leadership in the development and implementation of Payroll, Accounting and Residuals systems based on C-ISAM files for the leading company in the entire Entertainment Industry.

Elevated to Lead Developer by optimizing legacy code, enhancing program reliability and readability, and establishing coding standards, resulting in a significant improvement in maintainability and performance across the system.

Developed a preview mode for Entertainment Partners’ payroll engine, enhancing reliability, resulting in the most accurate pre-calculation capability in the industry, surpassing competitors' offerings and improving client satisfaction.

Implemented an XML data transfer system from Payroll to acquired company's versatile accounting system within two months, successfully meeting all requirements, and ensuring its continued use with minimal updates.

Converted outdated 16-bit Casting System programs to 32-bit, ensuring seamless operation on new Windows OS and preventing any productivity disruptions or slowdowns for the Casting group.

Provided expert QA testing and implementation of ISTQB methodology for the Residuals system; supported ongoing builds and deployment of updated code.

Led the technology transition from a legacy system into a more modern, reliable and more maintainable system.

positions.title: Interactive Technology and Digital Animation Engineering Director and Creator
positions.description:
Institutional leader and creator of the Interactive Technology and Digital Animation Engineering (ITDAE) major at Universidad del Valle de Mexico (Mexico's second largest private University with over 25 campuses).

Spearheaded Mexico's first Engineering major in computer graphics and animation, incorporating Engineering and Art: Interactive Technology and Digital Animation Engineering, therefore leading and fostering the creation and inception of similar majors by multiple universities.

Inspired thousands by pioneering a comprehensive Animation and Computer Graphics major, expanding focus beyond videogames, and positioning students for diverse industry opportunities in Mexico's vibrant digital sector.

Developed a collaboration link with Microsoft by incorporating the use of new technologies including Silverlight, C# and XNA into the ITDAE curriculum.

Reviewed, updated, and created many of the study plans for the ITDAE major.

positions.title: Mechatronics Engineering Major Director
positions.description:
Successfully managed the major curriculum while teaching classes and tending to students needs on campus.

Mentored student individuals and teams in diverse projects and competitions, obtaining many awards including many first places in national and international competitions in countries like Brazil, Peru and Arizona in the United States with the FIRST Robotics Competition.

Developed healthy and fruitful collaborations with the private industry and other academic institutions.

Acted as a judge in robotic competitions.

Reviewed technical articles for publications.
positions.insights: PLC programming and integration (Allen Bradley, Siemens)

positions.title: Supervisor Electronico, Departamento de Fuerza Motriz
positions.description:
Supervised the installation and start up of different state of the art automation systems throughout the entire beer brewing process.

Maintenance, replacement and calibration of all the electronic equipment from diverse brands such as Siemens, Schneider,  and Allen Bradley amongst many others, at the Mexico City Modelo brewing plant.
positions.insights: PLC programming and integration (Allen Bradley, Siemens)
